A.label: head control
A.domOwner: Unchanged PR head; ownership per docs/module-map.md.

B.label: boot render option rollback
B.domOwner: core/boot.js orchestrates; core/catalog.js owns loadMenu/renderMenu and coffee DOM.
B.moduleMapContract: No ownership transfer; boot invokes documented catalog loader.

C.label: zt-lcp-head base block
C.domOwner: index.html early bootstrap; core/splash.js selects brand; menu.js/delivery.js own hydrated catalog DOM.
C.moduleMapContract: Inline LCP bootstrap and window.__ztPrimeMenuLcp / delivery hero bridge.

D.label: early brand guard base block
D.domOwner: index.html early brand guard; core/splash.js owns splash lifecycle and choice.
D.moduleMapContract: Inline guard and window.__brandSplashPending coordination with splash.js/boot.js.

E.label: state and splash rollback
E.domOwner: core/state.js owns shared initial state; core/splash.js owns splash lifecycle.
E.moduleMapContract: Restore state.js and splash.js; ownership unchanged.

F.label: base control
F.domOwner: Pinned base revision owners per docs/module-map.md.

C1.label: base zt-lcp-head; fetch/interception only
C1.domOwner: index.html early bootstrap; splash.js chooses brand; hydrated catalog DOM remains menu.js/delivery.js.
C1.moduleMapContract: No DOM ownership change; restore only marked head block from pinned base.

C2.label: clone JSON without dynamic preload link
C2.domOwner: index.html bootstrap; delivery.js retains hydrated hero ownership.
C2.moduleMapContract: Parse cloned response but do not create a dynamic preload link.

C3.label: dynamic preload without response.clone()
C3.domOwner: index.html bootstrap; delivery.js retains hydrated hero ownership.
C3.moduleMapContract: Consume original response JSON and reconstruct an equivalent Response for app interception.

C4.label: dynamic preload only for splash selection
C4.domOwner: index.html bootstrap; splash.js owns explicit selection; hydrated catalog remains menu.js/delivery.js.
C4.moduleMapContract: Dynamic clone/preload only if splash was pending at document start; explicit brand relies on server Link header.

C5.label: delivery-only non-blocking preload side effect
C5.domOwner: index.html bootstrap; delivery.js owns delivery hero reconciliation; menu.js owns coffee catalog.
C5.moduleMapContract: Original response remains app critical path; only delivery gets cloned JSON/preload side effect.
